complete_examples.text: The method for constructing the track slab by double beam, thin plate and Mindlin-Reissner plate theory has been presented in [9, 21-22], which can be used as references.
In this study three types of finite elements, i.e., double-beam, thin-plate and Mindlin-Reissner plate, are introduced to model the track slabs.

With consideration of the shear deformation, Mindlin-Reissner plate element can be applied, and it is shown that the track slab and bridge accelerations with modelling of the Mindlin-Reissner plate are slightly smaller than those by double-beam and thin-plate track slabs at specifically high frequency ranges.
